title: Align microcompact trigger semantics
objective: Remove Go's unconditional legacy microcompact behavior and implement the TS-equivalent time-based and optional cached microcompact semantics.
implementation_scope: Require an explicit main-thread query source before time-based microcompact can fire.
Trigger time-based clearing only when the gap since the last assistant message exceeds configured threshold.
Always keep at least one recent compactable tool result.
Suppress compact warnings and reset cached microcompact state after time-based clearing.
Notify cache-break detection that cache deletion/drop is expected.
Disable the current every-request count-based clearing unless implementing a true cached cache_edits path for supported providers.
Expose clear configuration defaults and tests matching TS behavior.
out_of_scope: Do not implement auto-compact orchestration in this task.
Do not implement provider cache_edits unless the existing provider abstraction already exposes it cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: A normal non-idle request leaves messages unchanged.
A time-based idle main-thread request clears only older compactable tool results.
Undefined or non-main query source never triggers time-based microcompact.
Tests prove no mutation of input message slices.
risks: Changing default microcompact behavior can increase token usage until auto-compact/reactive compact are complete.
Warning suppression and cache-break notification may require small interfaces in the query loop.
dispatch_prompt: Align Go microcompact with the current TS semantics: no unconditional legacy clearing, time-based main-thread trigger, warning suppression, and cache-break coordination.
